M=np.array(B62,float); idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AA)}
def nwB(a,b,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); ai=[idx.get(c,22) for c in a]; bi=np.array([idx.get(c,22) for c in b]); NEG=-1e9
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pIx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pIy=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Mx[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+(i-1)*ge; pIx[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+(j-1)*ge; pIy[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sc=M[ai[i-1],bi]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            o=(Mx[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(o));Mx[i,j]=o[k]+sc[j-1];pM[i,j]=k
            o=(Mx[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(o));Ix[i,j]=o[k];pIx[i,j]=k
            o=(Mx[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(o));Iy[i,j]=o[k];pIy[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax((Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m])));P=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: P.append((i-1,j-1));ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: ns=pIx[i,j];i-=1
        else: ns=pIy[i,j];j-=1
        st=int(ns)
        if i==0 and j>0: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0: st=1
    return P[::-1]
t2o=dict(zip("ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL".split(),"ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"))
CHG={'D':-1.,'E':-1.,'K':1.,'R':1.,'H':0.1}
def parse(txt,chains=None):
    out={}
    for l in txt.splitlines():
        if not l.startswith("ATOM"): continue
        ch=l[21]
        if chains and ch not in chains: continue
        an=l[12:16].strip(); rn=int(l[22:26]); rs=l[17:20].strip(); el=(l[76:78].strip() or an[0])
        if el=='H' or rs not in t2o: continue
        xyz=(float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]))
        d=out.setdefault(ch,{'ca':{}, 'res':{}, 'at':[], 'b':{}})
        d['at'].append((rn,t2o[rs],an)+xyz)
        if an=='CA': d['ca'][rn]=xyz; d['res'][rn]=t2o[rs]; d['b'][rn]=float(l[60:66])
    for ch,d in out.items():
        k=sorted(d['ca']); d['nums']=np.array(k); d['CA']=np.array([d['ca'][i] for i in k])
        d['seq']="".join(d['res'][i] for i in k); d['BF']=np.array([d['b'][i] for i in k])
        d['XYZ']=np.array([a[3:] for a in d['at']]); d['RN']=np.array([a[0] for a in d['at']])
        d['AAs']=np.array([a[1] for a in d['at']]); d['AN']=np.array([a[2] for a in d['at']])
    return out
af=parse(S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8DII1-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=60).text)['A']
ek=parse(S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1EK9.pdb",timeout=60).text,chains="ABC")
print("1EK9 chain seqs identical:", ek['A']['seq']==ek['B']['seq']==ek['C']['seq'])
pairs=nwB(af['seq'],ek['A']['seq'])
def kab(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); U,S_,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    return (Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T), None
def sup(mob,ref,pr):
    P=mob[[i for i,_ in pr]]; Q=ref[[j for _,j in pr]]
    for cut in [12,9,7,5,4,3.5]:
        pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); U,S_,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
        R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T; t=qc-R@pc
        d=np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1); keep=d<cut
        if keep.sum()<60: break
        P,Q=P[keep],Q[keep]
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); U,S_,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T; t=qc-R@pc
    return R,t,float(np.sqrt((((R@P.T).T+t-Q)**2).sum(1).mean())),len(P)
tri_xyz=[];tri_aa=[]
for c in "ABC":
    R,t,rms,nc=sup(af['CA'],ek[c]['CA'],pairs)
    tri_xyz.append((R@af['XYZ'].T).T+t); tri_aa.append(af['AAs'])
TRI=np.vstack(tri_xyz); TRIAA=np.concatenate(tri_aa)
NAT=np.vstack([ek[c]['XYZ'] for c in "ABC"]); NATAA=np.concatenate([ek[c]['AAs'] for c in "ABC"])
cen=NAT.mean(0); vt=np.linalg.svd(NAT-cen,full_matrices=False)[2]; e3=vt[0]
e1=np.cross(e3,[0,0,1.]); e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1); e2=np.cross(e3,e1); Rf=np.vstack([e1,e2,e3])
NATf=(NAT-cen)@Rf.T; TRIf=(TRI-cen)@Rf.T

def charge_profile(P,aas,dz=5.,rlim=14.):
    zs=np.arange(P[:,2].min()+5,P[:,2].max()-5,dz); q=[];nres=[]
    rad=np.sqrt(P[:,0]**2+P[:,1]**2)
    for z in zs:
        m=(np.abs(P[:,2]-z)<dz/2)&(rad<rlim)       # atoms lining the lumen
        aa=aas[m]
        q.append(sum(CHG.get(a,0.) for a in aa)/max(1,len(aa))*100)  # net charge per 100 lumen-lining atoms
        nres.append(m.sum())
    return zs,np.array(q),np.array(nres)
z1,q1,n1=charge_profile(NATf,NATAA); z2,q2,n2=charge_profile(TRIf,TRIAA)
print("\nNet formal charge per 100 lumen-lining atoms (within 14 A of the 3-fold axis):")
print("  E. coli TolC (1EK9)      : overall %+.2f   min %+.2f  max %+.2f"%(np.average(q1,weights=n1),q1.min(),q1.max()))
print("  Tvtlr1605 model          : overall %+.2f   min %+.2f  max %+.2f"%(np.average(q2,weights=n2),q2.min(),q2.max()))
tot=lambda aas: sum(CHG.get(a,0.) for a in aas)
print("\nWhole-protein composition (monomer):")
for nm,sq in [("E. coli TolC P02930 (1EK9 modelled)",ek['A']['seq']),("Tvtlr1605 Q8DII1 (AF)",af['seq'])]:
